BEFORERECOVERED

The bare-patch comeback

Dead zones like this usually trace back to compacted soil, grub damage, or burned roots — not a dead lawn. Fix the soil first, then seed into it.

Rx: soil check → aerate → overseed → feed
BEFORERECOVERED
⇔

The weed takeover, reversed

Weeds win when the grass is too thin to fight back. Clear them out, then thicken the turf so there’s no room — or light — for the next wave.

Rx: weed control → overseed thin zones → pre-emergent
BEFORERECOVERED
⇔

The yellow lawn, re-greened

Discoloration is a symptom, not a sentence — hungry roots, iron-poor soil, and uneven water all show up as yellow. Feed the cause and the color follows.

Rx: soil test → targeted feeding → watering fix

Full care, one crew

Everything a recovering lawn needs next

Recovery is the headline, but the day-to-day care is what keeps a Queens lawn thick season after season. Every service starts with the free estimate.

Lawn recovery & renovation

The specialty: diagnosing written-off lawns and rebuilding them with aeration, overseeding, and soil work instead of a costly full resod.

Weed control

Targeted treatment for crabgrass, clover, dandelions, and broadleaf weeds — plus pre-emergent so they don’t get a second season.

Fertilization & feeding

Season-timed feeding matched to what your soil is actually missing, so color and thickness build instead of burning out by July.

Aeration & overseeding

Opening compacted Queens soil so water, air, and seed reach the roots — the single biggest unlock for thin, tired turf.

Mowing & seasonal care

Regular cutting at the right height for the season, edging, and the spring and fall cleanups that keep a recovered lawn recovered.

Why Right Lawn Care

The call you make when the lawn’s been given up on

Right Lawn Care has served Jamaica, Queens for roughly 30 years — long enough to have seen every way a New York City lawn can fail: compacted soil, summer burn, grub damage, shade-starved corners, and weeds that out-competed the grass years ago.

The reputation that follows the company is the recovery. Where the standard answer is “rip it out and start over,” Right Lawn Care starts with a diagnosis — and most of the time, the lawn comes back without the resod bill.

Serving Jamaica and the surrounding Queens neighborhoods. Not sure your block is covered? Ask on the callback — coverage is confirmed before anything is booked.
